# @gernst/bootstrap — maintained Bootstrap forks

> Two maintained Bootstrap forks modernized for 2026-era stacks, published as
> `@gernst/bootstrap` on npm.

## Versions

- `v4-modern`: fork of Bootstrap 4.6.2 — jQuery 3.5+/4, Popper 2, Dart Sass 2/3, works with
  AdminLTE 3. Demo: https://guillaume-ernst.github.io/bootstrap/demo/v4/
- `v5-modern`: fork of Bootstrap 5.3.8 — vanilla JS, Popper 2, deprecation-free Sass with a
  parallel @use/@forward module tree. Demo: https://guillaume-ernst.github.io/bootstrap/demo/v5/

## Docs

- Repository: https://github.com/guillaume-ernst/bootstrap
- AGENTS.md on each branch documents the migration from the `bootstrap` package step by step.
